### cleaning age disaggregation 
```{r}
clean_meningitis_data <- function(file_path, year_value) {
  
  # Read header rows
  headers <- read_excel(file_path, n_max = 2, col_names = FALSE)
  
  h1 <- as.character(headers[1, ])
  h2 <- as.character(headers[2, ])
  
  # Fill merged headers
  h1 <- zoo::na.locf(h1, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  # Combine headers
  new_names <- ifelse(
    is.na(h2),
    h1,
    paste(h1, h2, sep = "_")
  )
  
  new_names <- janitor::make_clean_names(new_names)
  
  # Load data
  df <- read_excel(file_path, skip = 2, col_names = new_names)
  
  # Rename key columns
  df <- df %>%
    rename(
      week_label = na_weeks,
      district = na_districts
    )
  
  # Fix structure
  df <- df %>%
    fill(week_label) %>%
    filter(!is.na(district))
  
  # Create epidemiological week
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      epi_week = match(week_label, unique(week_label)),
      year = year_value
    )
  
  # Clean variable names
  df <- df %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("bacterial_meningitis_", "", .x)) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("_years", "", .x)) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("_year$", "", .x)) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("death", "deaths", .x))
  
  return(df)
}
```

### combine the data 

```{r}
data_all <- bind_rows(data1, data2)
```

### create total variables 
```{r}
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(
    suspected_total = rowSums(select(., suspected_0_4, suspected_5_14, suspected_15), na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed_total = rowSums(select(., confirmed_0_4, confirmed_5_14, confirmed_15), na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_total = rowSums(select(., deaths_0_4, deaths_5_14, deaths_15), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

### national summmary 
```{r}
national_summary <- data_all %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    suspected = sum(suspected_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed = sum(confirmed_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths = sum(deaths_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cfr_percent = round((deaths / suspected) * 100, 1)
  )

national_summary
```
```{r}
library(writexl)

write_xlsx(
  national_summary,
  "national_meningitis_summary_clean.xlsx"
)
```

#### distributuon of cases 

```{r}
# =========================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# =========================
# STEP 1: CALCULATE NATIONAL TOTAL (2026)
# =========================
total_2026 <- data_all %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(suspected_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(total)

# =========================
# STEP 2: BUILD DISTRICT TABLE
# =========================
district_2026_full <- data_all %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(
    suspected = sum(suspected_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed = sum(confirmed_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths = sum(deaths_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = round((suspected / total_2026) * 100, 1),
    cfr = round((deaths / suspected) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cfr = ifelse(suspected == 0, NA, cfr)  # avoid NaN
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(suspected))

# =========================
# STEP 3: CREATE GT TABLE
# =========================
gt_table <- district_2026_full %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Distribution of Meningitis Cases by District",
    subtitle = paste0("Zambia, Weeks 1–16, 2026 (Total Cases: ", total_2026, ")")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    district = "District",
    suspected = "Suspected Cases",
    proportion = "Contribution (%)",
    confirmed = "Confirmed Cases",
    deaths = "Deaths",
    cfr = "CFR (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(suspected, confirmed, deaths),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(proportion, cfr),
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    -district
  ) %>%
  grand_summary_rows(
    columns = c(suspected, confirmed, deaths),
    fns = list(Total = ~sum(., na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# =========================
# STEP 4: SAVE AS WORD DOCUMENT
# =========================
gtsave(
  gt_table,
  "district_distribution_2026.docx"
)
```

### top 10 districts 

```{r}
# =========================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================
# STEP 1: PREP DATA (TOP 10 + ORDERING)
# =========================
top10_plot <- district_2026_full %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    district = factor(district, levels = district)  # ensures descending order
  )

# =========================
# STEP 2: BUILD COMPACT VERTICAL BAR CHART
# =========================
p <- ggplot(top10_plot, aes(x = district, y = proportion)) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#6BAED6",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    width = 0.6   # slimmer bars
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "District",
    y = "Contribution (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))  # reduce vertical padding
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()
  )

# =========================
# STEP 3: VIEW
# =========================
p

# =========================
# STEP 4: EXPORT (SLIDE-READY)
# =========================
ggsave(
  "top10_districts_compact.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### distribution by age

```{r}
# =========================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# =========================
# STEP 1: SUMMARISE DATA (2026)
# =========================
age_2026 <- data_all %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  summarise(
    suspected_0_4 = sum(suspected_0_4, na.rm = TRUE),
    suspected_5_14 = sum(suspected_5_14, na.rm = TRUE),
    suspected_15 = sum(suspected_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    confirmed_0_4 = sum(confirmed_0_4, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed_5_14 = sum(confirmed_5_14, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed_15 = sum(confirmed_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    deaths_0_4 = sum(deaths_0_4, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_5_14 = sum(deaths_5_14, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_15 = sum(deaths_15, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# =========================
# STEP 2: BUILD BASE TABLE
# =========================
age_table <- data.frame(
  age_group = c("0–4 years", "5–14 years", "15+ years"),
  suspected = c(age_2026$suspected_0_4,
                age_2026$suspected_5_14,
                age_2026$suspected_15),
  confirmed = c(age_2026$confirmed_0_4,
                age_2026$confirmed_5_14,
                age_2026$confirmed_15),
  deaths = c(age_2026$deaths_0_4,
             age_2026$deaths_5_14,
             age_2026$deaths_15)
)

# =========================
# STEP 3: CALCULATE TOTALS
# =========================
total_sus <- sum(age_table$suspected)
total_conf <- sum(age_table$confirmed)
total_deaths <- sum(age_table$deaths)

# =========================
# STEP 4: FORMAT n (%)
# =========================
age_table_final <- age_table %>%
  mutate(
    suspected = paste0(suspected, " (", round((suspected / total_sus) * 100, 1), "%)"),
    confirmed = paste0(confirmed, " (", round((confirmed / total_conf) * 100, 1), "%)"),
    deaths = paste0(deaths, " (", round((deaths / total_deaths) * 100, 1), "%)")
  )

# =========================
# STEP 5: CREATE GT TABLE
# =========================
gt_age <- age_table_final %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Distribution of Meningitis Cases by Age Group",
    subtitle = "Zambia, Weeks 1–16, 2026"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    age_group = "Age Group",
    suspected = "Suspected n (%)",
    confirmed = "Confirmed n (%)",
    deaths = "Deaths n (%)"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    -age_group
  )

# =========================
# STEP 6: SAVE AS WORD
# =========================
gtsave(
  gt_age,
  "age_distribution_2026.docx"
)
```

### merge and calculate the rates
```{r}
district_rates_2026 <- data_all %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  left_join(district_pop, by = "district") %>%
  group_by(district, population) %>%
  summarise(
    suspected = sum(suspected_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed = sum(confirmed_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths = sum(deaths_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    confirmed_rate = round((confirmed / population) * 100000, 1),
    suspected_rate = round((suspected / population) * 100000, 1),
    death_rate = round((deaths / population) * 100000, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(confirmed_rate))


district_rates_2026
```


### attack rates for the reporting districts 

```{r}
# =========================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# =========================
# STEP 1: FILTER DISTRICTS WITH CONFIRMED CASES
# =========================
district_cases_only <- district_table_final %>%
  filter(confirmed > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(attack_rate))

# =========================
# STEP 2: CLEAN COLUMN NAMES
# =========================
district_cases_only <- district_cases_only %>%
  rename(
    District = district,
    Population = population,
    `Confirmed Cases` = confirmed,
    `Attack Rate (per 100,000)` = attack_rate
  )

# =========================
# STEP 3: CREATE FORMATTED TABLE
# =========================
ft <- flextable(district_cases_only)

ft <- ft %>%
  colformat_num(j = "Population", big.mark = ",") %>%   # format population nicely
  autofit() %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(i = 1:5, bold = TRUE)   # highlight top 5 districts

# =========================
# STEP 4: CREATE WORD DOCUMENT
# =========================
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Districts Reporting Confirmed Meningitis Cases", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_par("Zambia, Weeks 1–16, 2026", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("Table shows districts with at least one confirmed case, ranked by attack rate.", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)

# =========================
# STEP 5: SAVE DOCUMENT
# =========================
print(doc, target = "district_attack_rate_cases_only_2026.docx")
```

### case fatality rates by age group 


```{r}
# =========================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================
# STEP 1: SUMMARISE DATA (2026)
# =========================
cfr_age_2026 <- data_all %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  summarise(
    confirmed_0_4 = sum(confirmed_0_4, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed_5_14 = sum(confirmed_5_14, na.rm = TRUE),
    confirmed_15 = sum(confirmed_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    deaths_0_4 = sum(deaths_0_4, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_5_14 = sum(deaths_5_14, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_15 = sum(deaths_15, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# =========================
# STEP 2: BUILD CFR TABLE
# =========================
cfr_table <- data.frame(
  Age_Group = c("0–4 years", "5–14 years", "15+ years"),
  Confirmed = c(cfr_age_2026$confirmed_0_4,
                cfr_age_2026$confirmed_5_14,
                cfr_age_2026$confirmed_15),
  Deaths = c(cfr_age_2026$deaths_0_4,
             cfr_age_2026$deaths_5_14,
             cfr_age_2026$deaths_15)
)

# =========================
# STEP 3: CALCULATE CFR SAFELY
# =========================
cfr_table <- cfr_table %>%
  mutate(
    CFR = ifelse(
      Confirmed == 0,
      NA,
      round((Deaths / Confirmed) * 100, 1)
    )
  )

# =========================
# STEP 4: SORT HIGH → LOW
# =========================
cfr_table <- cfr_table %>%
  arrange(desc(CFR))

# =========================
# STEP 5: FIX ORDER FOR PLOTTING
# =========================
cfr_table$Age_Group <- factor(
  cfr_table$Age_Group,
  levels = cfr_table$Age_Group
)

# =========================
# STEP 6: CREATE CHART (NO LABELS)
# =========================
p_cfr <- ggplot(cfr_table, aes(x = Age_Group, y = CFR)) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#6BAED6",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Case Fatality Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# =========================
# STEP 7: VIEW PLOT
# =========================
p_cfr

# =========================
# STEP 8: EXPORT IMAGE
# =========================
ggsave(
  "cfr_by_age_2026_clean.png",
  plot = p_cfr,
  width = 7,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```
